The '''Mechanics Union Auxiliary Meeting Hall''', or more simply the '''Mechanics Union Hall''' or '''Union Hall''', was a secondary meeting location for members of the [[Ugnaught Mechanics Union]]. The hall was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]] and could be seen from the [[Action Tidings Tower|''Action Tidings'' Tower]]. It was connected to [[Tralkov's Bar]] via underground tunnels.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />

The primary meeting hall was located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Mining Quarter]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
